mechanism: Phenytoin induces hepatic metabolism of corticosteroids, potentially reducing prednisolone efficacy, while ophthalmic prednisolone has minimal systemic absorption but topical steroids may mask infection symptoms that phenytoin use could predispose to.
action: Monitor clinical response to ophthalmic prednisolone; consider increased frequency or concentration if therapeutic effect is inadequate; maintain infection surveillance given phenytoin's immunosuppressive effects.
